description: This source file defines serialization and cloning logic for unknown or null types within the Orleans.Serialization framework, specifically implementing VoidCodec and VoidCopier classes.

classes.name: VoidCodec
classes.description: A serializer for types that are unknown or null, implementing IFieldCodec.

classes.name: VoidCopier
classes.description: A deep copier for unknown or null types, implementing IDeepCopier.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field, using ReferenceCodec to handle references, and throws if value is not null.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value expecting a reference wire type, returning a reference obtained via ReferenceCodec.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object, or throws if input is not null.
